cells.tense: The ending is here, and the mind is working cleanly inside it.
cells.act: start something for the spark of starting
cells.ask: Begin a page, a sketch, a talk with someone you'd work with — then stop at ten minutes with nothing planned past it. Let the stop be part of it.
cells.core:
The ending is here and your thinking is clear inside it. You're not fighting the fact of what's finished. You're reading what's still in place, what the next thing could hold, and the reading is sharp because it moves fast and doesn't flinch. That precision has been carrying you through the last stretch of this. The old shape is closing and the new one isn't built, and you can hold both at once without dressing either up.

Seeing it clearly won't move the clearing into a beginning by itself. So begin a page, a sketch, a call — for the spark of having started, not for where it lands. It doesn't have to mean anything yet. Beginning is the part your mind doesn't trust your hands to do. Let your hands do it anyway.
cells.sheetLine: You can see the clearing clearly. Begin something inside it.
cells.verb: Cutting through to what's true, at speed
cells.place: In the doorway at the end of something, where what's finished is finally allowed to be finished

cells.tense: You're already past the ending in your head, laying out what happens after the clearing finishes.
cells.act: cut through the inertia with one decisive act
cells.ask: Pick one concrete piece of this clearing — one call, one email, one box — and do only that this week. Leave the rest of the plan alone until it's done.
cells.core: Where something is ending, your mind has already run ahead and built the far side. You know what you'll be on the other side of this; the next conversation is rehearsed, the roles are handed out. Seeing what comes next is what you do better than almost anyone, and it's real. But the clearing doesn't finish faster because you've imagined past it. You're in the doorway while the door stays open behind you, and the push to be out is the same push that hasn't let you be here. So cut through one concrete thing — one call, one email, one box — and make that the whole of what you clear this week. The rest can wait.

cells.tense: The ending happened, and your mind is still working the old material as if it hasn't.
cells.act: pursue the emotional truth with someone
cells.ask: Ask one person what this ending was like from where they stood — the real answer, not the polite one. Then sit with it and don't explain it back.
cells.core: Where something ended, the mind is still working the old material. You can reason about it beautifully — the reasons, the timeline, what it meant and who was right — and none of that reasoning has to land in your body, so it doesn't. You're holding the analysis instead of the ending. The fast mind has been your shelter here, not your tool. The place you're in is running on empty, and more thinking won't fill it. So ask someone you trust what this ending was like from where they stood, and take the real answer, not the polite one. When they answer, let their words reach you without running them through the same machine. That's where the current comes from — not another lap around the pattern.

cells.tense: You're cutting through to what's true at speed, and the speed has no author.
cells.act: hold space for what someone feels without fixing it
cells.ask: When someone hands you something heavy, sit with it for two minutes without solving it. Let them finish. Then say what you actually feel, not the fix. Do that once.
cells.core: You can cut to what's true in a situation faster than almost anyone, and in the middle of a clearing, that speed looks like someone else's work. You name the ending as if it were happening to you rather than through you. The mind is at full speed, the clearing is underway, and the one doing the cutting isn't on the record. In the middle of all that, someone near you is feeling something. The fast part of you has somewhere to put the truth, but no place to put their face. Stay with them past the point where the answer is obvious. The answer isn't the point right now.
